metadata.title: Electronic Submission Template for Medical Device Q-Submissions: Draft Guidance for Industry and Food and Drug Administration Staff
metadata.topic: Draft guideline · FDA human drugs and biologics
metadata.legal_basis: FDA Guidance Document (21 CFR 10.115). Guidance states FDA's current thinking and is not binding unless a statute or regulation requires it; the official text governs.

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.

candidates.statement: In section 745A(b)(3) of the FD&C Act, Congress granted explicit statutory authorization to 38 FDA to specify in guidance the electronic submissions requirement by providing standards, 39 criteria for waivers and exemptions, and a timetable for such submissions. Accordingly, to the 40 extent that this document provides such requirements under section 745A(b)(3) of the FD&C 41 Act, indicated by the use of mandatory words, such as must or required, this guidance is not 42 subject to the usual restrictions in section 701(h) of the FD&C Act and FDA’s good guidance 43 practices (GGPs) regulations, such as the requirement that guidances not establish legally 44 enforceable responsibilities. See 21 CFR 10.115(d). 45

candidates.statement: Given that an electronic submission properly prepared with an electronic submission template 167 should represent a complete submission, 16 eSTAR submissions are not anticipated to undergo a 168 refuse to accept (RTA) process. candidates.context: Current Electronic Submission Template Structure, 153 Format, and Use 154 The electronic submission template, eSTAR, is the only currently available electronic 155 submission template at this time to facilitate the preparation of Q-Sub electronic submissions. 156 eSTAR consists of a collection of questions, text, logic, and prompts within a template that 157 guides a user through construction of a ‘complete’ Q-Sub 15 submission. eSTAR is highly 158 automated, includes integrated databases (e.g., FDA product codes , FDA-recognized voluntary 159 consensus standards ), and includes targeted questions designed to collect specific data and 160 information from the submitter. eSTAR also includes applicable links to regulations, relevant 161 guidances, and other resources for the submitter’s reference. Electronic Submission Template Waivers, Exemptions, 198 and Timing 199 Upon finalization of this draft guidance, all Pre-Subs, including Originals, Supplements, and 200 Amendments, unless exempted below in Section VI.A of this guidance, will be required to be 201 submitted as electronic submissions as of the implementation date. A Pre-Sub that is not 202 provided as an electronic submission as of that date and as described in Section V above , will not 203 be received unless an exemption from the electronic submission requirements applies. 204

candidates.statement: A. Waivers and Exemptions From Electronic Submission 206 Requirements 207 Above, FDA identified that Pre-Subs are subject to electronic submission requirements upon 208 finalization of this draft guidance after the implementation date. However, section 745A(b)(2) of 209 the FD&C Act allows for FDA to set forth criteria for exemptions and waivers from electronic 210 submission requirements. FDA has identified such criteria for Q-Subs below. 211

For a list of the known technical reasons, please refer to FDA’s CDRH Portal webpage, available at https://www.fda.gov/medical- devices/industry-medical-devices/send-and-track-medical-device-premarket-submissions-online-cdrh-portal
